description: AFIS - Geodätisches Festpunktfeld Land Bremen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Fixed points of location and height are proven in the Official Fixed Point Information System (AFIS). Content: Location: ETRS89 Reference System, GRS80 Ellipsoid, UTM Coordinate System Height: DHHN2016 The spatial reference of the official surveying system in Germany is realised by a uniform, homogeneous fixed point field throughout Germany. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "AFIS – Geodetic Fixed Point Field of Bremen" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include AdVMIS, Alk, Liegenschaft, Vermessung. The listing shows 2024-05-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
